searchText: Just wondering, are we actually going to skip implementing shard chains and go straight to docking with the beacon chain? Cause imo, it would be better we get the shard chains and all other necessary eth2.0 features and specs up and running first before we attempt to dock as per the roadmap <dankrad> Shard chains aren't useful before the merge, whereas the merge is immediately useful <dankrad> So we are doing it in that order
